versions.purpose: IoT feature patch — Modbus RTU / RS485 support and sensor reading UI.

sections.title: IoT — Modbus RTU / RS485 Active Polling
items: Added native Modbus RTU direct polling over serial port (COM port on Windows, /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux).
Added Modbus RS485 half-duplex support (rtu+rs485 scheme with DE/RE pin toggling).
Serial port parameters configurable per device: baud rate, data bits, parity (N/E/O), stop bits.
Supports same FC03 / FC04 function codes and all data types (uint16/int16/uint32/int32/float32) as Modbus TCP.
Background poller now covers modbus_tcp, modbus_rtu, and modbus_rs485 protocols.

sections.title: IoT — Sensor Display UI
items: Added sensor type classification per device: temperature, humidity, temperature+humidity, power, voltage, current, pressure, CO₂, PM2.5.
Added sensor reading card grid on IoT page — shows current value with unit (°C, %, W, V, etc.) and online/offline/error status.
Device list table now shows sensor type and target (IP:port for TCP, serial port for RTU/RS485).
Measurement values in tables now display with unit auto-detected from metric name.
Relative timestamps (e.g. "3m ago") on sensor cards for quick freshness check.

sections.title: IoT — Add Device Modal
items: Replaced inline form with modal dialog and protocol tabs (Modbus TCP / Modbus RTU / Modbus RS485).
TCP tab shows Host IP and Port fields; RTU/RS485 tab shows serial port, baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits.
All Modbus register fields (unit ID, address, FC, data type, scale, offset, endian, poll interval) shared across tabs.

sections.title: IoT — Protocol Capabilities
items: Updated protocol profile list to mark Modbus RTU and Modbus RS485 as Ready (active poll).
MQTT, OPC-UA, BACnet remain Bridge Ready (push ingest via REST API).

sections.title: UI Layout
items: IoT page restructured with clear section titles: Sensor Readings → Device List → Recent Measurements → Configuration → Embed Tokens.
Configuration cards (Forward Queue, Gateway Ingest Test, Embed Token, Allowlist) moved to a consistent grid layout with labeled form fields.

versions.purpose: Customer integration stable release for API, iframe embed, and IoT gateway integration.

sections.title: Customer Integration Stable Contract
items: Promoted the customer integration documentation to v1.2.4.8 as the current stable contract.
Clarified integration readiness statuses as Ready, Bridge Ready, and Planned so customer-facing API scope is explicit.
Kept /api/v1/integrations/network-snapshot as the preferred customer dashboard bootstrap API.
Kept iframe embed integration based on scoped embed tokens, server-side token revocation, and runtime frame-ancestors allowlist management.
Kept IoT direct Modbus TCP polling and REST ingest as Ready integration paths.
Marked MQTT, OPC-UA, and BACnet gateway ingest as Bridge Ready, with native protocol clients reserved as Planned.

sections.title: IoT Edge Buffer Update
items: Enabled automatic polling for configured modbus_tcp signal points with FC03 Holding Register and FC04 Input Register support.
Added metric, polling interval, scale, offset, byte order, and word order fields for Modbus TCP points.
Added durable local SQLite store-and-forward behavior for Modbus TCP readings and REST ingest measurements.
Added HTTP forwarder settings and queue APIs so customer systems can receive NMS-normalized IoT values.
Added offline retry with backoff. Failed forwards stay on the NMS host until the customer endpoint is reachable again.
Added post-success retention: forwarded IoT records are marked sent, kept locally for 10 minutes, then dropped by cleanup.
Added queue visibility for pending, failed, and sent-hold records.

sections.title: Security Hardening
items: Redacted device and PDU SNMP community values from normal API JSON responses while preserving internal polling behavior.
Device and PDU updates now preserve the stored SNMP community when the update request leaves the community field blank.
Camera API responses redact credentials and sensitive query parameters from RTSP URLs.
Expanded audit and log detail redaction for password, token, API key, secret, authorization, and SNMP community fields.
iframe and IoT integration UI now shows security guidance for scoped tokens, HTTPS, allowlists, short token lifetime, and OT network isolation.

sections.title: UI and Layout
items: Hardened audit, admin, embed, and IoT table layouts against long JSON, token, URL, IP, and identifier strings.
Mobile and tablet table containers now keep content inside the page boundary with controlled horizontal scrolling.
Confirmed monitor mode naming remains 電視牆模式.

sections.title: Release Packaging
items: Added a dedicated Linux ARM64 packaging path for customer delivery.
The dedicated ARM64 package contains only the ARM64 server binary, ARM64 go2rtc helper, Linux start script, release notes, API manual, and a package manifest.

sections.title: Documentation
items: Updated docs/API_MANUAL.md for v1.2.4.8 customer integration readiness.
Added customer security validation gates for credential redaction, iframe token handling, OT network segmentation, and gateway ingest controls.
Added smart-building 2016 / 2024 alignment notes with official Ministry of the Interior reference links.
Updated docs/STABLE_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md to track the current v1.2.4.8 acceptance state.
Bumped backend runtime version, frontend app version, static asset version, and service-worker cache to v1.2.4.8.

versions.purpose: Harden customer iframe integration management and expand IoT gateway integration readiness.

sections.title: Customer Integration
items: Added server-side embed token records so admins can list and revoke iframe tokens after issuing them.
Embed snapshot requests now reject revoked or expired embed tokens through the token jti record.
Added runtime iframe frame-ancestors allowlist settings through /api/v1/integrations/settings.
Added admin UI controls on the IoT / Modbus page for iframe allowlist management and embed token revocation.
Added IoT protocol capability profiles for direct Modbus TCP plus REST, MQTT bridge, OPC-UA gateway, and BACnet gateway ingest paths.

sections.title: Documentation and Versioning
items: Updated docs/API_MANUAL.md to v1.2.4.7, including embed token management, iframe allowlist management, and IoT protocol profile guidance.
Bumped backend, frontend app version, static asset version, and service-worker cache to v1.2.4.7.

versions.purpose: Add customer integration API optimization and publish the API manual.

sections.title: API Integration
items: Added GET /api/v1/integrations/network-snapshot as a customer-facing read API combining dashboard summary, device inventory, and topology into one response.
Added include, page, limit, search, type, and status query support so clients can trim payload size.
The integration payload uses schema version nms.integration.network_snapshot.v1 and omits sensitive fields.
The endpoint stays behind the existing JWT, license lock, and device_management gates.
Added scoped iframe embed tokens and the read-only /embed.html shell for customer portals.
Added IoT/Modbus integration APIs for Modbus TCP polling and REST/webhook ingest.

sections.title: Documentation and Versioning
items: Added docs/API_MANUAL.md for customer integration, including authentication, 2FA, the optimized snapshot API, iframe embed, IoT/Modbus APIs, existing read APIs, write API boundaries, status codes, and integration recommendations.
Bumped backend, frontend, static asset, and service-worker versions to v1.2.4.6.
Renamed the Traditional Chinese monitor page label from 監控畫面 / 監控模式 to 電視牆模式.

versions.purpose: Fix report export format handling and expand compliance/operations export coverage.

sections.title: Reports and Exports
items: Fixed report export format handling so CSV/PDF requests no longer fall back to JSON output.
Added richer device and inventory export fields, including sys name, firmware, location, SNMP uptime, interface counts, PoE count, and aggregate traffic counters.
Added disk usage to the device health report and SNMP uptime to the availability report.
Added new export reports for interfaces/PoE/traffic, health trend summaries, SLA evidence, audit/change records, license capacity, camera inventory, PDU/UPS inventory, and access-control inventory.
Standardized report UI labels and CSV/PDF export titles, headers, and common status values through the report i18n path.
Added CSV/PDF buttons for the new reports and synced frontend assets into both backend static trees.

sections.title: Security and Data Handling
items: Report exports intentionally omit sensitive values such as passwords, SNMP communities, full license keys, and RTSP URLs.
License capacity export masks license keys to a short prefix.

sections.title: Build and Versioning
items: Bumped backend, frontend, static asset, and service-worker versions to v1.2.4.5.
Added duration_days binding to the license generation input so the modular license generator compiles cleanly.
Added report-module tests covering PDF format routing, expanded CSV fields, and the new report SQL paths.

versions.purpose: Promote the validated encoder-camera preview and recording fixes to an obfuscated release build.

sections.title: Camera Streaming
items: MJPEG remains the default low-latency preview path for both management mode and monitor mode.
WebRTC/MSE remains opt-in through localStorage.nms-camera-preview-transport = "webrtc".
Failed WebRTC sessions in monitor mode now fall back to MJPEG instead of leaving black camera tiles.
Preview defaults keep high-quality MJPEG output with NMS_CAMERA_PREVIEW_QUALITY=2.
Camera debug logging is disabled by default in this release.

sections.title: Recording
items: Recording uses FFmpeg direct RTSP by default.
Recording no longer passes the unsupported -rw_timeout input option, fixing FFmpeg startup failures on affected builds.
Recording writes MPEG-TS first and remuxes after FFmpeg exits, preserving the .ts file if MP4 remux fails.

sections.title: UI
items: Restored local SVG icon rendering for legacy icon placeholders.
Service worker monitor-page fallback now returns a valid response instead of surfacing 'Failed to convert value to Response'.

versions.purpose: Test low-latency FFmpeg/MJPEG preview with go2rtc RTSP fanout.

sections.title: Camera Streaming
items: Default browser preview is back to the FFmpeg/MJPEG low-latency path.
WebRTC/MSE remains available as an opt-in test path through localStorage.
MJPEG preview first tries to pull from go2rtc's local RTSP fanout, then falls back to direct RTSP if go2rtc is unavailable.
Recording continues to use FFmpeg and can pull from the same go2rtc local RTSP stream.

versions.purpose: Optional go2rtc/WebRTC live-preview integration for lower-latency camera monitoring.

sections.title: Camera Streaming
items: Added a go2rtc-backed WebRTC preview path for camera live view, monitor mode, and dashboard camera tiles.
NMS starts go2rtc on demand, keeps the go2rtc HTTP API bound to 127.0.0.1, and proxies WebRTC signaling through authenticated NMS routes.
Browser playback now prefers WebRTC and automatically falls back to the existing MJPEG stream when WebRTC/go2rtc is unavailable.
RTSP URLs and credentials remain managed by NMS; the browser does not receive direct RTSP credentials.
Windows packages include go2rtc.exe; Linux packages include both go2rtc_linux_amd64 and go2rtc_linux_arm64.

versions.purpose: Inspection build for validating corrected translations and stable local SVG icons.

sections.title: Frontend
items: Corrected Logs & Audit translations across zh-TW, zh-CN, ja-JP, and ko-KR.
Added a local SVG icon layer for navigation, status cards, header actions, and mobile navigation.
Bumped static cache version to v1.2.4.1-i18n-icons1.

versions.purpose: Customer-deliverable PoC build that retains the upgrade path to a formal UUID license without replacing the binary.

sections.title: PoC Runtime
items: Version packaged as v1.2.4-PoC, aligned with the v1.2.4 mainline.
PoC build defaults to default_device_limit = 0, keeping device management locked.
Customers can import a PoC License to unlock device count and module capabilities for testing.

sections.title: License Promotion
items: /api/v1/system/info and Dashboard version label dynamically switch based on actual license state.
When a valid standard UUID license is present, the version label automatically changes from v1.2.4-PoC to v1.2.4.
PoC License and Trial do not remove the PoC label to avoid confusion with formal shipment licenses.

sections.title: Frontend Alignment
items: Login page and mode-selection page sync the backend runtime version label on load.
Static asset version remains v1.2.4; switching to a formal license does not require replacing the entire software package.

versions.purpose: Logs & Audit hardening — refactor scattered system logs and audit records into a searchable, exportable, traceable formal module.

sections.title: Logs & Audit
items: Added a dedicated main navigation entry: Logs & Audit.
Split into four record types: Audit Logs, System Logs, Device Logs, Config Changes.
Each log type supports independent query, filtering, and individual export.

sections.title: Audit Coverage
items: Added high-value operation auditing: user login / logout / failed login, license add / activate / trial, device / camera add / edit / delete, topology changes, PoE on / off / recycle, device reboot, system config changes.
Audit detail changed to structured JSON instead of loose strings.
Added recordset_id and correlation_id to link operations in the same batch.

sections.title: Config Change
items: Added config change records preserving before / after diff for devices, cameras, licenses, topology, and system settings.
Change source distinguished: manual, batch, auto_discovery, system_sync.

sections.title: Presentation and Export
items: Frontend display unified, loaded from i18n for other locales.
Export formats include at minimum CSV and JSON, with filter conditions, time range, export time, and record count.

sections.title: Compliance Direction
items: Aligned with smart building governance requirements and management traceability.
Enhanced evidence support for ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO 9001.
This release targets 'closer to auditable', not a completed certification claim.

versions.purpose: Introduces the dedicated PoC licensing line, locks device management by default, and adds a dual-mode generator for Formal and PoC licenses.

sections.title: License / PoC
items: New v1.2.1-PoC line with default_device_limit = 0 by default.
Device management stays locked until a valid license enables device_management or grants licensed device capacity.
PoC licenses are not bound to Machine ID and support custom device count and exact expiry time.
Formal licenses remain Machine ID bound.

sections.title: Generator
items: Added a dedicated generator with separate Formal License and PoC License interfaces.
Formal licenses require Machine ID and generate machine-bound keys.
PoC licenses can define custom expiry time and device count without UUID binding.

sections.title: Frontend / Gate
items: Device and topology entry points now rely on /api/v1/license/features and device_management.
Unauthorized device and topology read/write APIs are blocked by the backend.

versions.purpose: Monitor mode and topology stabilization, camera preview switching fix, recording naming correction, and version convergence.

sections.title: Monitor / Topology
items: Fixed residual placeholder and garbled text in monitor topology and tooltips.
After collapsing a tree node, parent node correctly shows red breathing indicator if any child device is offline.
Admin mode backend topology synced with the same collapsed-offline indicator.
Topology statistics column and speed text display unified to avoid residual development strings.

sections.title: Camera / Recording
items: Fixed backend stale stream issue causing camera preview to stop updating after switching from Monitor back to admin mode.
Recording list and export filename now prioritize camera_recordings.camera_name instead of falling back to cam1/cam2/cam4 style naming.
New recordings preserve a snapshot of the camera name at recording time.

sections.title: UI / Release
items: Cleaned up visible garbled text and raw key display across camera module, recording management, delete buttons, and monitor prompts.
Version display and static asset cache-busting version number unified to v1.2.3.
License page now shows 永久授權 (Permanent License) when the license term reaches 50 years or more.

versions.purpose: Bandwidth alert notifications, camera password decryption fallback, topology tree hierarchy fix.

sections.title: Alert Notifications
items: Camera MJPEG stream bandwidth limit exceeded now writes a bell notification.
Network device bandwidth alert: if interface traffic exceeds 80% of link speed during SNMP polling, a notification is written with a 5-minute cooldown.
Alert notifications can be viewed, marked as read, and cleared from the top-right bell panel.

sections.title: Topology Fix
items: Removed the erroneous inference that same-type switches directly connected are HA pairs. Only explicit link_type=ha/vrf/spine_leaf merges same-tier nodes.
Downstream devices such as IPCAM now correctly attach under their upstream switch.

sections.title: Camera Module
items: When an old encrypted password cannot be decrypted with the current AES-GCM key, the system automatically falls back to parsing the plaintext password from the RTSP URL, fixing 401 Unauthorized errors.

versions.purpose: Topology tree node collapse, IPCAM bitrate configuration, monitor mode topology fix.

sections.title: Topology Enhancements
items: Tree topology node collapse/expand: clicking a node with child devices collapses or expands it; collapsed nodes show a numeric visual indicator.
Collapse state persisted in browser localStorage and restored on page reload.
Main page (Monitor) and admin mode share the same topology rendering logic for visual and configuration consistency.

sections.title: Camera Module
items: Added Recording Bitrate (kbps) field in camera settings.
If bitrate > 0, recording uses libx264 transcoding to meet bandwidth requirements; 0 maintains stream copy (high efficiency) mode.
Recording source supports ONVIF protocol connection to ensure the recording stream is correctly updated.

versions.purpose: Monitor mode formalization, dual-mode login architecture, role-directed console, i18n completion.

sections.title: Monitor Mode
items: demo.html officially renamed to monitor.html; route changed from /demo to /monitor.
Badge and title suffix support 5 locales with real-time switching (zh-TW / zh-CN / EN / ja / ko).
System name display fixed: prioritizes sysName, then custom name, fallback IP.
Topology link disappearance on auto-refresh fixed: compares node/link IDs and triggers full rebuild when structure changes.

sections.title: Dual-Mode Console
items: Added mode-selection.html: after login, users are redirected here to choose mode.
Role-directed display: admin/editor sees both Admin Mode and Monitor Mode cards; viewer sees only Monitor Mode.
Admin mode top-right Monitor Mode button changed to Home Console, returning to mode-selection page.
Monitor mode Exit returns to console (preserves token, no re-login required).

sections.title: Login Flow Refactor
items: After successful login, users are always redirected to mode-selection.html.
Login and password change force cache-bust (equivalent to Ctrl+F5) to ensure the latest JS/CSS is loaded.
Opening the login page while already logged in automatically redirects to mode-selection page.

sections.title: i18n Completion
items: Fixed login page login mode dropdown not switching with locale.
Added login.mode_label / login.mode_admin / login.mode_monitor to each language file.
Fixed camera edit modal labels, placeholders, and buttons to use t() i18n calls.
Delete confirmation dialogs and operation success/failure toasts fully i18n-ized.

versions.purpose: Demo display mode completion, camera RWD improvements, viewer permission hardening, UI bug fixes.

sections.title: Demo / Monitor Mode
items: Fully implemented Demo page (/demo): no logout or re-login required.
Left side: interactive network topology (D3.js, zoomable/draggable); right side: device statistics cards and real-time event log.
Supports 5 locales: zh-TW / zh-CN / EN / ja / ko.
Supports dark / light theme toggle (persisted to localStorage).
5-second auto-refresh updating device on/off status and link traffic (without resetting zoom/pan).

versions.purpose: EdgeCore SSH integration, PoE control, camera GPU acceleration, FFmpeg auto-download.

sections.title: EdgeCore SSH Integration
items: Supports ECS2100-10P, ECS4150, ECS2220 series.
SSH command sequences: backup, reboot, PoE ON/OFF/Recycle.
isPrompt fix: !<stackingDB> no longer mis-detected as prompt.

sections.title: PoE Control
items: PoE ON/OFF/Recycle (SSH priority, SNMP fallback).
Real-time per-port power consumption (EdgeCore private OID).
PoE power summary card (total / used / progress bar >85% red >60% orange).

sections.title: Camera Enhancements
items: GPU-accelerated streaming (NVIDIA CUDA / Intel QSV / AMD VAAPI / D3D11VA).
